description: Agent-based, networked simulation of mask adoption dynamics with social influence, information campaigns, policy mandates and enforcement, mobility and location policies, and market supply constraints. Agents interact on a small-world social network and traverse locations with varying policies; risk signals, media/government messages, peer observation, and market access jointly drive adoption decisions and persistence.

modules.name: InformationAndBeliefModule
modules.description: Broadcast and assimilation of information from media and government, including misinformation dynamics and trust updates; updates person risk_perception and trust_in_authority.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each person i:
  media_signal = media_campaign_strength * Media.message_intensity * Media.reach * Media.credibility * (1 - abs(Media.bias))
  gov_signal = (mandate_active ? 1 : 0) * policy_stringency
  misinformation = i.misinformation_exposure * misinformation_intensity
  # Update risk perception with weighted signals and local prevalence
  local_signal = location_prevalence_signal_strength * Location[i.location_id].local_prevalence_signal
  base = base_risk_level
  signal_total = base + local_signal + media_signal + gov_signal - misinformation
  # Assimilation weighted by trust and sensitivity
  alpha = clamp(0.1 + 0.4 * i.trust_in_authority + 0.2 * i.risk_sensitivity, 0, 1)
  i.risk_perception = clamp((1 - alpha) * i.risk_perception + alpha * signal_total + Normal(0, media_noise_sigma), 0, 1)
  # Trust update (slow drift toward media credibility and mandate signal)
  i.trust_in_authority = clamp(i.trust_in_authority + trust_update_rate * (Media.credibility - i.trust_in_authority) + 0.05 * (mandate_active ? 1 : -1), 0, 1)
  # Misinformation decay/correction
  i.misinformation_exposure = clamp(i.misinformation_exposure * (1 - misinformation_decay_rate) + Bernoulli(misinformation_rate)*(1 - Media.credibility), 0, 1)
notes: Trust nudges toward media credibility and is modulated by mandate status.
Misinformation increases with exogenous rate scaled by (1 - credibility) and decays over time.

modules.name: SocialInfluenceModule
modules.description: Agents observe mask-wearing among their network neighbors and households, forming a peer norm signal that adjusts propensity to adopt.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each person i:
  peers = i.network_neighbors
  frac_wearing = mean(j.adoption_state for j in peers)
  # include household effect if available
  if Household[i.household_id] exists:
    frac_household = mean(adoption_state of members)
  else:
    frac_household = frac_wearing
  observed = (1 - household_peer_weight) * frac_wearing + household_peer_weight * frac_household
  peer_norm_i = clamp(observed + Normal(0, peer_observation_noise), 0, 1)
  store signal.peer_norm_i for i
notes: peer_norm_i is an information signal used by the AdoptionDecisionModule.
household_peer_weight places additional weight on intra-household norms.

modules.name: MobilityAndLocationModule
modules.description: Daily mobility and location entry; assigns people to locations subject to capacities and base policies.

update_rule.pseudocode:
reset foot_traffic counters
for each person i:
  # sample visits
  p_work = (is_weekday ? p_visit_work_weekday : p_visit_work_weekend)
  p_school = (is_weekday ? p_visit_school_weekday : p_visit_school_weekend)
  visits = sample_bernoulli({work:p_work, school:p_school, store:p_visit_store, public_transport:p_visit_public_transport, public_space:p_visit_public_space})
  # prioritize single primary visit (work/school > store > public_transport > public_space)
  chosen = argmax_priority(visits)
  assign i to a random Location of that type with available capacity; if none, choose next priority or stay home
  increment foot_traffic and current_occupancy
  record i.location_id
notes: Baselines can be extended by demographic-dependent schedules.

modules.name: RetailMarketModule
modules.description: Mask retail supply, restocking, pricing, and rationing; processes purchase attempts and updates inventories.

update_rule.pseudocode:
stockouts_today = 0
# restock and price adjust
for each retailer r:
  if day % retailer_restock_interval == 0:
    r.inventory_level += supply_capacity_per_day
  inv_ratio = r.inventory_level / (1 + supply_capacity_per_day)
  r.price_per_mask = max(0.1, mask_price * (1 + price_adjustment_sensitivity * (1 - inv_ratio)))
  if r.inventory_level == 0: stockouts_today += 1
# purchase attempts
for each person i who intends_to_wear (from adoption decision):
  desired_qty = max(0, target_inventory - i.mask_inventory)
  if desired_qty > 0:
    affordable_price = (r.price_per_mask - subsidy_per_mask)
    budget_limit = max_daily_mask_spend_fraction_income * i.income
    qty_by_budget = floor(budget_limit / max(affordable_price, 0.1))
    qty = min(desired_qty, qty_by_budget)
    if rationing_enabled: qty = min(qty, retailer_rationing_limit_per_purchase)
    choose retailer with highest inventory_level
    purchased = min(qty, retailer.inventory_level)
    retailer.inventory_level -= purchased
    i.mask_inventory += purchased
    i.daily_cost_accumulated += max(affordable_price, 0.0) * purchased
notes: Subsidy reduces effective price for the buyer.
Price adjusts inversely with inventory levels to mimic scarcity pricing.
Target inventory is an implicit policy (e.g., 5 masks).

modules.name: PolicyEnforcementModule
modules.description: Applies mandates and location enforcement; issues warnings/denials/fines; computes deterrence feedback.

update_rule.pseudocode:
# Toggle mandate by schedule
mandate_active = include_policy_mandate and (day >= mandate_start_day) and (day <= mandate_end_day)
# Reset counters and capacity
events = 0
remaining_capacity = enforcement_capacity_per_day
for each person i at location L:
  requires_mask = mandate_active or L.mask_policy_required
  if requires_mask and (i.adoption_state == 0):
    prob_check = enforcement_probability * L.enforcement_strictness
    if remaining_capacity > 0 and Bernoulli(prob_check):
      remaining_capacity -= 1
      # fine with probability prop to strictness; else denial/warning
      if Bernoulli(0.5 * L.enforcement_strictness):
        i.daily_cost_accumulated += fine_amount
      events += 1
      # deterrence signal increases compliance tendency for tomorrow
      det = enforcement_deterrence_factor * L.enforcement_strictness
      store signal.enforcement_deterrence_i for i = det
# output
observable.enforcement_events_daily = events
notes: Mandate applies system-wide; base location policies remain when mandate is off.
Deterrence signal is consumed by the AdoptionDecisionModule.

modules.name: AdoptionDecisionModule
modules.description: Combines risk, peer norms, enforcement deterrence, cost considerations, and habit formation to decide wearing; updates mask usage and habit.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each person i:
  X = w_r * i.risk_perception + w_p * signal.peer_norm_i + w_t * i.trust_in_authority + w_c * i.compliance_propensity + w_e * signal.enforcement_deterrence_i
  # cost pressure if low inventory and high price; approximated by affordability term
  affordability = clamp(1 - mask_affordability_weight * (1 - min(1, (max_daily_mask_spend_fraction_income * i.income) / (mask_price + 1e-6))), 0, 1)
  latent = X * affordability - i.adoption_threshold
  p_wear = sigmoid(logistic_beta * latent + Normal(0, decision_noise_sigma))
  # habit persistence: if wore yesterday, increase propensity; if not, decay habit
  if i.adoption_state == 1:
    p_wear = clamp(p_wear + 0.5 * i.habit_persistence, 0, 1)
    i.habit_persistence = clamp(i.habit_persistence, 0, 1)  # persist
  else:
    i.habit_persistence = clamp((1 - habit_decay_rate) * i.habit_persistence, 0, 1)
  # decide
  wear_today = (i.mask_inventory > 0) and Bernoulli(p_wear)
  i.adoption_state = 1 if wear_today else 0
  # consume mask inventory if wearing
  if wear_today:
    i.mask_inventory_consumed_buffer += masks_used_per_day_if_wearing
    if i.mask_inventory_consumed_buffer >= 1.0:
      use = floor(i.mask_inventory_consumed_buffer)
      i.mask_inventory = max(0, i.mask_inventory - use)
      i.mask_inventory_consumed_buffer -= use
  # purchase intent if inventory below target and p_wear is high
  intent_to_buy = (p_wear > 0.5) and (i.mask_inventory < target_inventory)
  emit signal.intent_to_wear_mask = wear_today or intent_to_buy
notes: Weights w_r, w_p, w_t, w_c, w_e are derived from peer_influence_weight and normalized; by default w_r=0.3, w_p=peer_influence_weight_mean, w_t=0.2, w_c=0.15, w_e=0.15.

requirements: Access to current mask_price for affordability

modules.name: HealthRiskSignalModule
modules.description: Generates base and location-specific prevalence signals for risk perception; can operate in constant or seasonal modes.

update_rule.pseudocode:
if risk_signal_process == 'constant':
  base = base_risk_level
elif risk_signal_process == 'seasonal':
  base = clamp(base_risk_level + risk_signal_amp * sin(2*pi*day/period_days), 0, 1)
else: # 'pulse'
  base = base_risk_level + risk_signal_amp * (day in pulse_days ? 1 : 0)
# Location-specific variation
for each location L:
  noise = Normal(0, 0.05)
  L.local_prevalence_signal = clamp(base + noise, 0, 1)
emit signal.base_risk = base
notes: Simple deterministic-exogenous signals to avoid epidemiological coupling.
If pulse_days used, it is internally generated as [mandate_start_day-7, mandate_start_day, mandate_end_day+7].

modules.name: AdoptionAggregator
modules.description: Aggregates daily observables and computes time-series required by metrics.

update_rule.pseudocode:
adoption_rate_daily = mean(i.adoption_state for all persons)
high = filter(income >= high_income_threshold)
low = filter(income < high_income_threshold)
adoption_rate_high_income_daily = mean(adoption_state over high)
adoption_rate_low_income_daily = mean(adoption_state over low)
average_cost_per_person_cumulative = mean(i.daily_cost_accumulated cumulative)
# pass-through of other observables captured today
emit enforcement_events_daily, stockouts_daily
notes: Costs are cumulative from day 0 to current day.
Income threshold separates groups for inequality metric.

initialization.network_generation: Watts-Strogatz small-world with avg_degree and rewiring_prob
initialization.households: Sample household sizes ~ Poisson(household_size_mean-1)+1, assign members; set shared_inventory=0
initialization.locations: Create locations per counts_by_type with capacities and base mask policies
initialization.retailers: Create retailer_count with initial inventory_level=supply_capacity_per_day, price_per_mask=mask_price
initialization.media: Initialize with credibility, reach, bias, message_intensity
initialization.persons: Draw attributes per entity initialization; connect to network; set initial locations=home

algorithms.adoption_decision: Logistic choice with habit, affordability, enforcement deterrence, and thresholds; stochastic via Gaussian noise
algorithms.belief_update: Weighted assimilation of media/government and local prevalence signals with trust dynamics and misinformation decay
algorithms.mobility: Independent Bernoulli draws with priority selection and capacity-constrained assignment
algorithms.enforcement: Capacity-constrained Bernoulli checks combined with location strictness; probabilistic fines and deterrence emission
algorithms.retail_market: Periodic restocking, scarcity-based price adjustment, rationing; greedy retailer selection for purchases
algorithms.aggregation: Daily rollups of adoption rate, group-wise adoption, costs, enforcement events, and stockouts
